sql: SELECT TOP 10 cs.ConfigurationSetCode AS configurationSetCode, cs.ConfigurationSetDisplayName AS configurationSetName FROM dbo.ZnodePluginConfigurationSet cs INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePluginConfigurationSetMapper m ON m.PluginConfigurationSetId = cs.PluginConfigurationSetId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePluginScope sc ON sc.ScopeId = m.ScopeId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortal po ON po.PortalId = m.ExternalId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePluginDetails pd ON pd.PluginDetailsId = cs.PluginDetailsId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePluginTypes pt ON pt.PluginTypeId = pd.PluginTypeId WHERE sc.Scope = @storeScope AND po.StoreCode = @store AND pt.TypeName IN (@pluginType, @internalPluginType) AND pd.IsActive = @isActive AND CHARINDEX(@subTypeMarker, cs.ConfigurationSetAttributeValues) > @zero ORDER BY LEN(cs.ConfigurationSetCode), cs.ConfigurationSetCode
